title: M.Sc. Computer Science
overview_en: M.Sc. Computer Science at Sample University of Milan is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover algorithms, distributed systems, machine learning and software engineering. It ends with a master's thesis, and a 3-month internship is optional.
overview_bn: এটি ২৪ মাসের কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স মাস্টার্স, ইংরেজিতে পড়ানো হয়। মূল কোর্সে অ্যালগরিদম, ডিস্ট্রিবিউটেড সিস্টেম, মেশিন লার্নিং ও সফটওয়্যার ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং আছে। শেষে থিসিস, আর ৩ মাসের ইন্টার্নশিপ ঐচ্ছিক।

title: M.Sc. Data Science and Economics
overview_en: M.Sc. Data Science and Economics at Sample University of Milan is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover statistics, machine learning, data engineering and data ethics. Students can take a part-time track over three years.

title: M.Sc. Global Public Health
overview_en: M.Sc. Global Public Health at Sample University of Milan is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy and global health. A 2-month field placement with a health organisation is required.

title: B.Sc. International Economics
overview_en: B.Sc. International Economics at Sample University of Milan is a 3-year bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover microeconomics, macroeconomics, econometrics and development economics. The first year includes a maths refresher for students from business backgrounds.

title: M.Sc. Sustainable Architecture and Urban Design
overview_en: M.Sc. Sustainable Architecture and Urban Design at Sample Milan Institute of Design and Technology is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Studio projects cover sustainable buildings, urban design and digital modelling. Applicants send a portfolio of 3–5 projects.

title: M.Sc. Fashion and Textile Technology
overview_en: M.Sc. Fashion and Textile Technology at Sample Milan Institute of Design and Technology is an 18-month master's program taught in English. Core courses cover fibre science, sustainable textiles, garment technology and supply chains. It includes a company project with a textile brand.

title: B.Eng. Computer Engineering
overview_en: B.Eng. Computer Engineering at Sample Milan Institute of Design and Technology is a 3-year bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover algorithms, distributed systems, machine learning and software engineering. The last semester is an industry internship.

title: M.Sc. Pharmaceutical Biotechnology
overview_en: M.Sc. Pharmaceutical Biotechnology at Sample University of Bologna is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover genetic engineering, bioprocesses, bioinformatics and laboratory work. The second year is mostly laboratory research for the thesis.

title: M.Sc. Sustainable Agriculture
overview_en: M.Sc. Sustainable Agriculture at Sample University of Bologna is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover crop science, soil management, agri-food systems and climate adaptation. Field trips to farms in the region are part of the first year.

title: M.Sc. Civil Engineering
overview_en: M.Sc. Civil Engineering at Sample University of Bologna is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover structural analysis, geotechnics, water engineering and construction management. Students choose a structures, water or transport track.

title: M.A. International Relations
overview_en: M.A. International Relations at Sample University of Bologna is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover research methods, policy analysis and international institutions. An exchange semester abroad is available in the second year.
overview_bn: এটি ২৪ মাসের আন্তর্জাতিক সম্পর্ক মাস্টার্স, ইংরেজিতে পড়ানো হয়। মূল কোর্সে গবেষণা পদ্ধতি, নীতি বিশ্লেষণ ও আন্তর্জাতিক প্রতিষ্ঠান আছে। দ্বিতীয় বছরে বিদেশে এক সেমিস্টার এক্সচেঞ্জের সুযোগ আছে।

title: MBA International Business
overview_en: MBA International Business at Sample Emilia Business School is a 1-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. At least 2 years of work experience are expected.

title: M.Sc. Finance and Fintech
overview_en: M.Sc. Finance and Fintech at Sample Emilia Business School is an 18-month master's program taught in English. Core courses cover corporate finance, financial markets, risk management and fintech. Courses include Python for finance and a trading lab.

title: BBA Business Management
overview_en: BBA Business Management at Sample Emilia Business School is a 3-year bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. Students do a 3-month internship in the third year.

overview_en: M.A. Digital Business Management at Sample Berlin University of Applied Sciences is an 18-month tuition-free master's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. At least 12 months of work experience are required.

title: B.Eng. Mechatronics
overview_en: B.Eng. Mechatronics at Sample Berlin University of Applied Sciences is a 42-month tuition-free bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover thermodynamics, mechanics, manufacturing and design with CAD. The sixth semester is a practical placement in industry.

title: MBA General Management
overview_en: MBA General Management at Sample Munich International Business School is an 18-month master's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. At least 3 years of work experience are expected.

overview_en: M.Sc. Marketing Analytics at Sample Munich International Business School is an 18-month master's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. Projects use real campaign data from partner companies.

title: B.Sc. International Management
overview_en: B.Sc. International Management at Sample Munich International Business School is a 42-month bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. A semester abroad at a partner school is part of the program.

title: M.Sc. Computer Science Engineering
overview_en: M.Sc. Computer Science Engineering at Sample University of Budapest is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover algorithms, distributed systems, machine learning and software engineering. An entrance interview is held online.
overview_bn: এটি ২৪ মাসের কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং মাস্টার্স, ইংরেজিতে পড়ানো হয়। মূল কোর্সে অ্যালগরিদম, ডিস্ট্রিবিউটেড সিস্টেম, মেশিন লার্নিং ও সফটওয়্যার ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং আছে। অনলাইনে ভর্তি ইন্টারভিউ হয়।

title: M.Sc. International Economics and Business
overview_en: M.Sc. International Economics and Business at Sample University of Budapest is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover microeconomics, macroeconomics, econometrics and development economics. Students can add a specialisation in EU trade.

title: M.A. Social Policy
overview_en: M.A. Social Policy at Sample University of Budapest is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover research methods, policy analysis and international institutions. Includes a placement with an NGO or public agency.

title: B.Sc. Business Administration and Management
overview_en: B.Sc. Business Administration and Management at Sample University of Budapest is a 42-month bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover strategy, marketing, operations, leadership and entrepreneurship. The seventh semester is a professional internship.

title: M.Sc. Structural Engineering
overview_en: M.Sc. Structural Engineering at Sample Danube Technical University is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover structural analysis, geotechnics, water engineering and construction management. Lab work uses a large structural testing hall.

title: M.Sc. Electrical Engineering
overview_en: M.Sc. Electrical Engineering at Sample Danube Technical University is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover power systems, control, embedded electronics and signal processing. Specialisations: power, telecom or embedded systems.

title: B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering
overview_en: B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering at Sample Danube Technical University is a 42-month bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover thermodynamics, mechanics, manufacturing and design with CAD. An optional foundation semester covers maths and physics.

title: M.Sc. Computer Science
overview_en: M.Sc. Computer Science at Sample University of Debrecen is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover algorithms, distributed systems, machine learning and software engineering. Classes are small, and a thesis is written with a faculty supervisor.

title: M.Sc. Agricultural Biotechnology
overview_en: M.Sc. Agricultural Biotechnology at Sample University of Debrecen is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover genetic engineering, bioprocesses, bioinformatics and laboratory work. Research projects run at the university's experimental farm.

title: M.Sc. Chemistry
overview_en: M.Sc. Chemistry at Sample University of Debrecen is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover analytical, organic and physical chemistry with laboratory work. Students choose an analytical or synthetic chemistry track.

title: B.Sc. Computer Science
overview_en: B.Sc. Computer Science at Sample University of Debrecen is a 3-year bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover algorithms, distributed systems, machine learning and software engineering. Students build a software project with a local company in the final year.

title: M.Sc. Public Health
overview_en: M.Sc. Public Health at Sample Debrecen College of Health Sciences is an 18-month master's program taught in English. Core courses cover epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy and global health. A field project with a regional health office is part of the final semester.
overview_bn: এটি ১৮ মাসের জনস্বাস্থ্য মাস্টার্স, ইংরেজিতে পড়ানো হয়। মূল কোর্সে এপিডেমিওলজি, বায়োস্ট্যাটিস্টিক্স, স্বাস্থ্যনীতি ও বৈশ্বিক স্বাস্থ্য আছে। শেষ সেমিস্টারে একটি আঞ্চলিক স্বাস্থ্য অফিসের সাথে ফিল্ড প্রজেক্ট করতে হয়।

title: M.Sc. Health Care Management
overview_en: M.Sc. Health Care Management at Sample Debrecen College of Health Sciences is a 2-year master's program taught in English. Core courses cover epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy and global health. Courses mix hospital management, health economics and leadership.

title: B.Sc. Biomedical Laboratory Science
overview_en: B.Sc. Biomedical Laboratory Science at Sample Debrecen College of Health Sciences is a 42-month bachelor's program taught in English. Core courses cover molecular biology, microbiology, immunology and laboratory methods. Clinical lab practice takes place in a teaching hospital.
